node.title: About Us — Our Story
node.body:
Our Mission: Built Between the Iron and the Water

Anchor Me Down was born from a simple belief: your clothes should work as hard as you do. Founded in Nashville, Tennessee, AMD creates premium heavyweight streetwear for those who live between the dock and the gym — people who demand more from their gear and refuse to settle for paper-thin basics that fall apart after a few washes.

We design every piece for the person who starts their morning pulling lines at the marina and ends it pulling iron at the gym. Our apparel bridges that gap between rugged durability and clean, modern style — because you shouldn’t have to choose between looking good and wearing something that lasts.

The Heavyweight Difference

At the heart of everything we make is our signature heavyweight cotton — the heaviest tees in the game. Most premium streetwear tees are cut far lighter, and you can tell the moment you hold one of each. Our cotton isn’t just heavier — it’s a completely different experience. The weight gives every tee a structured, substantial drape that holds its shape wash after wash. You feel the quality the moment you pick it up.

This isn’t heavyweight for the sake of being heavy. The density of our fabric means better color retention, less shrinkage, and a garment that actually improves with age. While other tees thin out and lose their form, AMD pieces develop character — softening where you need it while maintaining their shape everywhere else.

The Garment-Dyed Process

Every AMD piece is garment-dyed, meaning the fabric is cut, sewn, and then dyed as a finished garment rather than dyeing the fabric first. This process creates a rich, lived-in color depth that you simply cannot achieve with piece-dyed fabrics. Each garment has subtle color variations that make it uniquely yours, with a vintage-washed feel right out of the box.

Garment dyeing also means our colors age beautifully. Instead of fading unevenly, AMD pieces develop a natural patina over time — every wash adds character rather than taking it away.

Stay Anchored

“Stay Anchored” is more than our tagline — it’s a philosophy. In a world that moves fast and pulls you in every direction, staying anchored means knowing who you are and what you stand for. It means showing up consistently, putting in the work, and staying grounded no matter what comes your way.

Our anchor isn’t about being stuck — it’s about being steady. It represents the strength to hold your ground, the confidence to stand out, and the grit to keep going when things get tough. Whether you’re on the water, in the gym, or navigating life, AMD is built for people who stay anchored.

Nashville Roots

Anchor Me Down is proudly built in Nashville, Tennessee — a city that understands grit, creativity, and doing things your own way. Nashville’s energy of authenticity and craftsmanship runs through everything we create. We’re not chasing trends or cutting corners. We’re building premium heavyweight streetwear that stands the test of time, one garment at a time.

Shop the full collection and feel the difference for yourself.

node.title: About Us
node.body:
Where Iron Meets Water

Anchor Me Down Apparel was born from two worlds — the weight room and the waterfront. We're a premium nautical streetwear brand built for people who live with purpose, train with intensity, and carry themselves with the quiet confidence that comes from knowing exactly who they are.

This isn't fast fashion. This isn't trend-chasing. AMD is a lifestyle brand rooted in discipline, resilience, and an unshakable connection to the water. Every piece we create reflects that mentality — from the heavyweight fabrics we choose to the anchor that marks everything we make.

The Philosophy

An anchor doesn't hold you back — it keeps you grounded. That's the foundation of everything we do at AMD. In a world that's constantly pulling you in a hundred directions, we believe in planting your feet, knowing your values, and refusing to drift.

Our designs live at the intersection of nautical heritage and modern street culture. Clean lines, bold graphics, and a premium feel that sets AMD apart from everything else on the rack. When you put on an AMD piece, you know it. The weight of the fabric, the quality of the print, the way it fits — it all speaks to a standard most brands don't bother reaching for.

Built to Last

We don't do thin, disposable clothing. Every AMD tee, hoodie, and piece of headwear is crafted from premium heavyweight materials designed to hold up — wash after wash, session after session. We chose thick, durable fabrics because that's what this lifestyle demands. You need gear that performs whether you're deadlifting, docking a boat, or heading out for the night.

Our production partners meet strict ethical standards. Fair wages, safe conditions, sustainable practices. We'd rather make less and make it right than cut corners for a bigger margin.

The Community

AMD isn't just a brand — it's a crew. Our community is made up of lifters, sailors, fishermen, athletes, and everyday people who share a common thread: they show up, they put in the work, and they don't make excuses. When you wear the anchor, you're part of something bigger than a clothing line.

We're building this thing one drop at a time, one customer at a time, one rep at a time. And we're just getting started.

Connect With Us

Follow the journey on Instagram and TikTok at @anchormedownapparel. See what the crew is wearing, catch early access to new drops, and become part of the AMD movement.

Stay anchored. Stay hungry. Stay ready.

Get the perfect fit every time. Use the charts below to find your ideal size across all AMD apparel. Our gear runs true to size with a modern, athletic cut.

How to Measure

Chest: Measure around the fullest part of your chest, under your arms. Keep the tape level and snug.

Waist: Measure around your natural waistline — the narrowest point, usually just above the navel.

Length: Measure from the highest point of your shoulder down to where you want the garment to end.

Fit Recommendations

Between sizes? For a fitted look, go with the smaller size. For a relaxed fit or layering, size up.

Athletic build? Go true to size — our shirts are cut to accommodate a built frame without excess fabric around the midsection.

Tall and lean? Our lengths run generous. True to size should work well.

Hoodies: We recommend going true to size. The modern cut allows room for layering without looking oversized.

All AMD apparel is pre-shrunk, but proper care keeps everything looking and fitting its best:

node.title: FAQ — Frequently Asked Questions
node.body:
Got questions? We've got answers. No fluff, no runaround — just the information you need about AMD products, process, and what makes us different.

How heavy are AMD tees, really?

Heavier than anything else in your drawer. Most mall-brand tees are thin — they stretch out, go see-through, and give up within a season. AMD's flagship tees are the heaviest in the category: dense garment-dyed cotton with real substance you feel the second you pick one up. It matters because that weight is what holds a collar, keeps a shape, and makes a tee actually last.

What does the weight feel like?

Put it this way: our t-shirts carry more substance than most hoodies on the market. When you pick up an AMD tee, you'll feel the difference immediately — genuine heft without being stiff or uncomfortable. It's the kind of weight that makes everything else feel cheap by comparison.

What does "garment-dyed" mean?

Most tees are made from pre-dyed fabric (piece-dyed). We do the opposite — we construct the entire shirt first in raw cotton, then dye the completed garment. This creates richer, deeper color with natural variation, a softer hand-feel from day one, and color that ages gracefully instead of fading in blotches. Every AMD tee is genuinely one-of-a-kind because of how dye interacts with the finished garment's seams, folds, and fabric density.

How does AMD compare to Represent, Cole Buxton, and Fear of God?

On fabric alone, we outweigh them all. Our flagship tees are heavier than the premium names in this space — garment-dyed finish, double-stitched construction — at $60, a price that undercuts most of the competition. We're not saying those are bad brands. We're saying pick ours up next to theirs and you'll feel it.

What's the fit like? How should I size?

AMD tees have a relaxed, modern fit — not boxy, not slim. The heavyweight fabric creates a structured drape that skims your frame without clinging. We recommend going true to size for most builds. If you're between sizes or prefer a more oversized look, size up one. Check our size guide on each product page for exact measurements.

How do I care for my AMD tees?

Simple: wash cold, inside out, gentle cycle. Air dry flat or on a wide hanger when possible. If you use a dryer, low heat only. Avoid bleach — it'll damage the garment-dyed finish. That's it. The heavyweight fabric is built to handle regular wear and washing without losing shape, and the garment-dyed color actually improves with age when cared for properly.

Will the colors fade?

Not the way you're thinking. Piece-dyed shirts fade in ugly, blotchy patches. Garment-dyed fabric evolves — the color develops more character over time, similar to how a good pair of raw denim ages. It's a feature, not a bug. Your AMD tee at year two will have a unique patina that looks better than day one. Follow the care instructions (cold wash, no bleach) and you'll love how your tees develop over time.

Who's behind AMD?

Anchor Me Down was founded by people who got tired of the compromise. Tired of paying premium prices for lightweight fabric. Tired of "luxury basics" that fell apart in three months. Tired of brands that talk quality but can't back it up with specs. We built AMD to be the brand we wanted to buy from — transparent about materials, honest about process, and obsessive about getting the fundamentals right.

What does "Stay Anchored" mean?

It's our philosophy. In a market full of trends, hype cycles, and disposable fashion, we believe in staying grounded. Build something substantial. Don't chase trends — set a standard. Stay Anchored means investing in quality that lasts, being confident in who you are, and not getting pulled around by what everyone else is doing. It's on every label because it's in everything we make.

Where are your products made?

Our tees are manufactured using premium cotton and constructed with double-stitched seams at every stress point. The garment-dye process happens after construction, ensuring every piece meets our heavyweight standard. We work with manufacturing partners who share our commitment to quality and ethical production practices.

What's your return policy?

We stand behind every piece we sell. If your AMD tee doesn't meet your expectations, we'll make it right. Check our Returns & Exchanges page for full details on timelines and process. We want you to be completely satisfied — because once you feel heavyweight garment-dyed quality, we're confident you won't want to go back.

Do you ship internationally?

Yes. We ship worldwide because heavyweight quality shouldn't be limited by geography. International shipping rates and delivery times vary by destination — you'll see exact costs at checkout. All orders are carefully packaged to ensure your tees arrive in perfect condition, no matter where you are.

node.title: Accessibility Statement
node.body:
Our Commitment to Accessibility

At Anchor Me Down Apparel, we believe everyone deserves to shop with confidence and ease. We are committed to making our website accessible to all users, including those with disabilities. Our goal is to provide a seamless, inclusive online experience — because great style should be available to everyone.

Standards We Follow

We strive to conform to the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1 at the AA level. These guidelines help us ensure our site is perceivable, operable, understandable, and robust for all visitors, regardless of ability or assistive technology.

What We're Doing

Our ongoing accessibility efforts include: providing keyboard navigation and skip-to-content links, maintaining sufficient color contrast throughout the site, ensuring all interactive elements have clear focus indicators, adding descriptive labels to icons and form fields, optimizing for screen readers and other assistive technologies, and regularly reviewing our site against WCAG 2.1 AA standards.

Need Help or Have Feedback?

Accessibility is an ongoing effort, and we welcome your input. If you experience any difficulty accessing our site, or if you have suggestions for improvement, please reach out to us at info@anchormedown.com. We take all feedback seriously and will do our best to respond within two business days.

Accommodations

If you need assistance completing a purchase or navigating our site, we're happy to help. Contact us by email at info@anchormedown.com and we'll work with you to ensure you have full access to our products and services.

Last updated: March 2026

node.title: About Anchor Me Down Apparel
node.body:
Our Story

Anchor Me Down Apparel was born from a simple frustration: streetwear that falls apart. Founded by Don Morrison, AMD set out to build the heaviest, most durable garment-dyed streetwear on the market. Our collection spans different fabric weights and fits. Check each product description for its materials, construction, and care instructions.

Fabric with purpose

Heavy is our standard: dense, garment-dyed cotton that holds its shape. Weight alone is not a promise of quality or fit. Refer to each product description for the materials and construction details provided for that style.

Color and character

Colors and finishes vary by product. Follow the description and care instructions for the exact item you choose.

Built for the Dock and the Gym

Our designs draw from nautical heritage and gym culture. Whether you're pulling crab pots at dawn or pulling deadlifts at dusk, AMD gear is built to handle it. The oversized, relaxed fit moves with you, while the heavyweight fabric stays put.

Our Commitment

We stand behind every piece we make. Premium materials and honest pricing. See our current shipping policy for shipping terms. No gimmicks, no shortcuts — just the heaviest streetwear you'll ever own.

Stay Anchored

"Stay Anchored" isn't just our tagline — it's a mindset. Stay grounded. Stay committed. Stay true to who you are. That's what Anchor Me Down is all about.

About Anchor Me Down Apparel

Anchor Me Down Apparel is a premium heavyweight streetwear brand founded by Don Morrison. Our hero pieces are crafted from ultra-heavyweight garment-dyed cotton, bridging the gap between nautical lifestyle and gym culture. Based in the United States, AMD delivers streetwear that's built to last — heavier, softer, and more durable than standard brands.

Brand Facts

  • Website: anchormedown.com
  • Fabric: The heaviest tees in the game — garment-dyed cotton, nearly double the weight of a standard tee

Press Inquiries

For media inquiries, product samples, collaboration proposals, or interview requests, please contact us at info@anchormedown.com with the subject line "Press Inquiry." We aim to respond within 48 hours.

Brand Assets

High-resolution logos, product photography, and brand guidelines are available upon request. Please email info@anchormedown.com with your publication name and intended use.

Most streetwear brands build light. Anchor Me Down builds the heaviest tees in the game — a true ultra-heavyweight that you can feel the moment you pick it up. Combined with our garment-dye process, every piece develops a unique character over time. Our clothing is designed for people who live between the gym and the water — built to perform and built to last.
